D239 references Note 12 for details on loss exposure. D433 references Note 12 for details on commitments. While both reference Note 12, they refer to different sub-topics within Note 12 (securitization loss exposure vs credit extension commitments). However, the proposed group included D433 as a match for D239/D294. D294 (credit commitments) is better matched to D280. D239 (max loss exposure) is better matched to D214/D215/D216. D433 is a cross-reference to Note 12 regarding commitments, which is distinct from the securitization loss exposure topic of D239. comparisons.peer_topic: Maximum Loss Exposure on Retained Interests
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm's maximum loss exposure from retained and purchased interests in private-label securitization entities is limited to the carrying value of these interests.
comparisons.comparison: Both Bank of America and JPMorgan Chase explicitly define the scope of their maximum loss exposure regarding securitization interests. BAC discloses that this exposure includes obligations under loss-sharing reinsurance and other arrangements for non-agency residential and commercial mortgage securitizations, while explicitly excluding servicing advances and representation/warranty reserves. Similarly, JPM defines its maximum loss exposure from retained and purchased interests as limited to the carrying value of those interests, which serves as the cap on potential loss. Both disclosures focus on quantifying or limiting the maximum financial exposure arising from securitization positions.
